latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Clip Maker for YouTube — Cut and Export YouTube Clips.

- Supports uploading raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) for AI-driven clip editing and export.
- Fast cloud processing (30–60 seconds) with downloads in 1080p MP4 format.
- Simple authentication with free trial through anonymous token (100 credits/7 days).
- Handles session management, video uploads, status, credits, and export via a unified workflow.
- Guides users with clear error messages, file limits, and workflow tips.
- Designed for YouTubers wanting to quickly generate short, shareable clips from long-form recordings.
